I replied to Pree in a thread under her message in #central-team.

I couldn't confirm the 8 April date. There's no Brackenwater Freight Co. folder, contract or CRM record in the files I can see, and nobody has mentioned Brackenwater in #central-team before. I told her not to rely on the date until someone checks it against the signed contract. I suggested June Osei-Lark on the deal desk, or whoever owns the account, and offered to draft a message to either of them.

My reply says I'd "noted" the date, but I haven't saved it anywhere. The only record is the thread itself.
